inputs.slider: Shadcn UI slider customized with #E05D43 thumb and track.

animations_motion.estimator_reveal: The final amount is initially covered by a backdrop-blur-md overlay. Upon submitting Step 2, the blur animates to 0px, revealing a counting-up number.
animations_motion.hover_states: Buttons and interactive cards lift by -4px with an increased shadow.
animations_motion.marquee: Slow, organic horizontal scroll for trust badges/testimonials using react-fast-marquee.

hero_background.description: Stunning sunset view over rural fields in Australia. Use as a background with a bg-gradient-to-r from-[#F7F5F0] via-[#F7F5F0]/90 to-transparent overlay.

testimonials.description: Portrait of a young woman wearing a hat, representing a backpacker.
Smiling man with green mountaineering bag.

technical_rules.icons: Use lucide-react for all interface icons (security badges, navigation, dashboard icons).
technical_rules.testing: All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='calculate-refund-btn', data-testid='estimator-step-1-next').
technical_rules.forms: Use Shadcn customized components. Avoid native HTML select or inputs where possible.
technical_rules.accessibility: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. Do not rely solely on color for error states.

sections: Hero (Split layout: Text & Trust signals on left, Interactive Estimator Card on right over the sunset background)
Trust Marquee (Logos, '$X million recovered', 'TPB Registered Tax Agent')
How It Works (3-step visual bento grid)

estimator_flow.step_1: Visa Type (Buttons for 417/462 vs Other) & Balance input (Toggle between exact balance input OR earnings slider calculating 12%).
estimator_flow.step_2: Lead Capture (Name, Email, WhatsApp). The estimated refund is visible but BLURRED out behind a 'lock' gate. Call to action: 'Reveal My Refund'.
estimator_flow.step_3: Success State + Extra Details. Blur is removed, animating number reveals the $ amount. Form asks for Super Fund Name & Departure Date to finalize claim.

admin_dashboard.metrics: Top cards (Total Leads, Est Pipeline Value, Conversion Rate).
admin_dashboard.table: Lead list with columns (Name, Visa, Est Refund, Status Pipeline, Action).
admin_dashboard.status_pipeline: Badges for: New Estimate, Contacted, Documents Received, Submitted to ATO, Refund Paid.
